concerns.text: T015 (Motion filtering) depends on T005 (utils/motion.py implementation) but also reads from 'data/raw/HCP_1200/behavioral_metadata.csv'. T012 (Download) is the producer of this raw data file. T015 is listed in Phase 3 but does not explicitly depend on T012 completion. If T012 fails or is delayed, T015 cannot run. Add explicit dependency: [Depends on T012, T005].

T017 (Missing behavioral score handling) depends on T012 (Download) to provide the source CSV, but the dependency is not explicitly stated in the task header. It also writes to 'exclusion_log.csv' which is the same artifact T015 writes to. T017 must run after T012 and ideally in parallel or sequence with T015, but the current order implies T015 runs first. Ensure T017 explicitly depends on T012.

T024 (Null model) depends on T021, T022, and T013. T013 (Preprocess/Parcellation) produces the parcellated time-series required for T024. However, T013 is marked [P] (parallel) in Phase 3, while T024 is in Phase 4. The dependency chain is correct, but T024's description says 'Must use parcellated time-series from T013'. Ensure T013 is completed before T024 starts. The current phase separation handles this, but the explicit dependency tag is missing in T024's header (it lists T021, T022, T013 but T013 is in a different phase). This is acceptable if phases are strict, but T024 should explicitly list T013 as a dependency to avoid ambiguity if phases are relaxed.

T036 (Final merge) depends on T030, T031, T034, T026, T015, T017. T015 and T017 produce 'exclusion_log.csv'. T026 produces 'metrics.csv'. T034 produces 'regression_summary.json'. T036 merges these. However, T036 also needs the 'final_results.csv' schema which includes 'Subject_ID', 'Variability_Metric', etc. T026 produces 'metrics.csv' with 'Subject_ID', 'Variability_Metric', 'Entropy'. T030/T031/T034 produce regression stats. The dependency on T015/T017 is for the exclusion list, but T036 needs the *merged* data from T014 (which includes behavioral scores). T014 is not listed as a dependency for T036. T036 must depend on T014 to get the full subject list with behavioral scores to merge with regression results.

T004a is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T004 (Create config.py) to justify the 60s window deviation. The task description says 'The 60s window deviation... will be justified in docs/technical-design.md (T004a)'. T004a creates the justification. T004 creates the config. T004a does not depend on T004's *output* (the config file) to write the justification, but the justification references the config parameter. This is a semantic dependency. If T004a runs before T004, the config file might not exist to be referenced. Mark T004a as [Depends on T004] to ensure the config exists before the justification is written, even if the file creation is independent.

T025 (Batch processing logic) is listed in Phase 4 (US2) but depends on T021/T022 (connectivity.py implementation). T025 says 'Integrate batch logic into code/features/connectivity.py'. T021 and T022 implement the core logic. T025 must run after T021 and T022 are complete to integrate the logic. The dependency is implied but not explicit. Add [Depends on T021, T022] to T025.
